pick_title: archive: refuse symlinks inside the open each member already makes (openat2 RESOLVE… (truncated)
pick_reason: (not delivered: truncated) Reconstructed from the plan, the measurements and the replay programs: the open that each member already makes refuses symlinks in the kernel (Linux openat2 RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS, macOS O_NOFOLLOW_ANY), so a member in an existing directory costs the same one syscall as on main, nothing is cached between entries, and the refusal is atomic with the open (no window for a rename-exchange). The per-component O_NOFOLLOW walk with cached directory fds (the PR as written) stays only as the fallback where the kernel cannot refuse (no openat2, Android, FreeBSD). Private fresh destinations (bun install, --compile download) keep main's syscalls exactly through an explicit DestinationKind::PrivateFresh; the default is the strict CallerProvided.
why_not_minimal: (not delivered: truncated) From the siblings and plan: a leaf-only O_NOFOLLOW or a per-entry component walk (#31585) leaves parents followed or pays a walk per entry; the cached walk as written pays +1 or +2 syscalls per directory on every extraction, 2.75x on random order, and holds up to 128 descriptors; none of them makes the refusal atomic with the open.

plan_reconstructed_from_replay.file: fd = open_no_symlinks(root, path, O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_TRUNC). ENOENT with a dirname: make_parents(dirname), then the same open again. ELOOP: open the parent with open_no_symlinks(root, dirname, O_PATH|O_DIRECTORY); if that fails a parent component is a link: reject; else unlinkat(parent, name) and openat(parent, name, O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW); close the parent.
plan_reconstructed_from_replay.make_parents: Find the deepest existing ancestor: probe prefixes of n-1 .. 1 components with open_no_symlinks(root, prefix, O_PATH|O_DIRECTORY); an error other than ENOENT fails. Then for each missing component: mkdirat(parent fd, name, 0o755) (EEXIST is fine), step down with openat(parent fd, name, O_PATH|O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW), close the previous fd.
plan_reconstructed_from_replay.directory: parent = open_no_symlinks(root, dirname, O_PATH|O_DIRECTORY); ENOENT: make_parents then open again; failure: reject; mkdirat(parent, name, mode); close.
plan_reconstructed_from_replay.symlink: deferred to the end, parent as for a directory, symlinkat(target, parent, name).
plan_reconstructed_from_replay.variant: atomic: nothing is kept between entries (the measurement expects root + file + one transient parent descriptor).
plan_reconstructed_from_replay.fallback: where open_no_symlinks is None (kernel without openat2 or seccomp refusing it, Android, FreeBSD): the cached per-component O_NOFOLLOW walk of the PR as written (ParentDirs).
